filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selection provides strong coverage across all topics with highly relevant and popular videos. For Arabic, coverage is good for the first three topics, with a foundational math video chosen for 'Impulse Approximation' due to a lack of direct physics tutorials. No suitable Arabic video was found for 'Variable Mass Systems' as the only candidate failed the language gate.

coverage.note: Limited direct candidates. Selected a highly-viewed video on the Unit Impulse function, a core mathematical concept for this topic.
